build_symmetric_alignments: run the script to build symmetric word alignments for a machine translation dataset using fast_align and mosesdecoder
join_source_target_files: create a joined file from source and target language sentence files using the ||| delimiter
run_forward_alignment: run a forward pass of fast_align on the joined source and target text file
run_backward_alignment: run a backward pass of fast_align on the joined source and target text file
symmetrize_alignments: symmetrize forward and backward alignment files using a configurable heuristic like grow-diag-final-and
